timingDefinitions.totalMs: Wall time from review start to this snapshot; excludes PGN fetch and final DOM render
timingDefinitions.engineMs: Sum of actual non-cached search durations, nested in requestMs
timingDefinitions.requestMs: Serial awaited request time including IPC/cache/initialization; nested in baseMs/criticalMs/brilliantMs
timingDefinitions.initializationMs: Engine readiness wait inside requestMs; not additive
timingDefinitions.criticalMs: Critical-root and reply verification wall time, including requests and yields
timingDefinitions.classificationMs: All report assembly time; not additive with missMs
timingDefinitions.fetchMs: Separate import wall time, if measured in browser
timingDefinitions.renderMs: Separate rendering work; initial rendering may also be nested in totalMs
